_readme: 复制本文件为 trainer.config.json 后修改；所有字段都可以省略。tdxRoot 留空表示只探测有限的系统候选位置；找不到时请手动填写 tdxRoot 或显式设置 TDX_ROOT 环境变量，不把任何个人电脑路径写入默认配置。port 默认 8787；dataDir 留空表示 %USERPROFILE%\.a-share-kline-trainer；databasePath 可选，必须是绝对路径，留空表示 <dataDir>\trainer.sqlite。环境变量 TDX_ROOT、TRAINER_DB（绝对路径）设置时优先于本文件。修改本文件（或更换新版本包）后，请先运行 Stop.cmd 停止旧服务，再运行 Start.cmd；启动器检测到配置或版本不一致时会拒绝复用并提示先停止。关闭浏览器不会停止服务，停止服务一律用 Stop.cmd。Copy this file to trainer.config.json next to Start.cmd and edit as needed; every field is optional. Empty tdxRoot uses only a small set of generic system locations; if it is not found, set tdxRoot in this file or set the TDX_ROOT environment variable explicitly. After changing this file (or upgrading the package), run Stop.cmd before Start.cmd; the launcher refuses to reuse a mismatched running server.
